notes.title: Pope Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://wordsforevil.com/media/PopeUpdate.png[/img]

Hey Everyone!

I had a few bugs to fix, so I decided to add a new hero while I was at it.

Enjoy!


NEW HERO : Pope Vocabulary IX

A bunch of new words added to the dictionary

Bug - River Spirit would still sometimes not heal properly
Bug - Forest Shaman wouldn't always use her main attack
Bug - Strange bug with using keyboard to find words fixed

notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://wordsforevil.com/media/ChristmasUpdate.jpg[/img]

NEW HERO : Santa Claus
NEW HERO : Enchanted Snowman

COLOR BLIND MODE is now available in the Options Menu

A bunch of new words added to the dictionary - Gabe is now valid :)

Bug - River Spirit is no longer a narcissist (she now heals the lowest %HP)
Bug - Fixed two small issues with equipment stats
Bug - Fixed a small issue with the world spawner
Fix - Chance to find new heroes has been increased

Merry Christmas Everyone!
